    good to know

    tap a question
    Where do you serve?

    We're GTA-based and serve events across the GTA and beyond. Add your location to the inquiry and we'll let you know.

    What kinds of events do you do?

    Weddings, bridal showers, private celebrations, corporate events, brand activations and everything beyond.

    Can I customize the setup?

    Absolutely. Each package includes a custom menu for your event, and we can go further: branded cup labels, plus a setup styled to match your decor, colours and overall aesthetic, so the cart fits the vibe you're going for.

    How does pricing work?

    Packages are priced by guest count (see the guide below). They're based on your confirmed guest count and aren't unlimited unless stated. Events over 150 guests are custom quoted.

    How fast will I hear back?

    Within 48 hours of your inquiry.
